title: Margin Construction
slide_intent: Test a formula across aspect ratios because a consistent rule still needs optical judgment at extremes.
strategic_value: The same margin method can keep Burger King banners and posters related while avoiding unsuitable spacing in unusual formats.
demonstration: Three numbered diagrams apply 27 px margins to 674 px horizontal examples and 30 px margins to a 756 px vertical example.
practical_value: Apply the longest-side calculation, using the rounded displayed examples and preserving the optical exception.

content_islands.name: Construction explanation
content_islands.spec: Place the rule and extreme-format note at upper left.

content_islands.name: Three diagrams
content_islands.spec: Stack a wide banner over a taller format at center and place a vertical format at right, with measured margins.

content_islands.name: Calculation key
content_islands.spec: Place the three numbered equations beneath the explanatory column.

ingredient.name: Margin construction across formats
ingredient.role: Carry proportional spacing while allowing optical correction.
ingredient.application: Use longest side/25; the examples round 674 px to 27 px and 756 px to 30 px. Adjust extreme wide or tall formats manually if needed.
ingredient.scope: Historical 2020 partner guidelines, PDF produced January 2021. The source gives displayed rounded values but does not define a general rounding algorithm.

reference_purposes.Intent: The text explains that the modular margin scales proportionately across application sizes.
reference_purposes.Application: The three diagrams demonstrate 674/25 as 27 px and 756/25 as 30 px.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Very wide or tall applications may need manual margin adjustment for optical correctness.
